verdict: No arXiv submission dated after 2026-05-27 narrows the s>=5 off-diagonal graph Ramsey polylog gap.  The only in-window asymptotic work on r(s,t) at s>=4 is the s=4 line (Chen 2610.15293: r(4,t)=t^3/(log t)^{2+o(1)}, which USES the s>=5 lower bounds as input; Lin-Zhang 2610.17891: r(4,t)>=t^3/(log t)^{2+o(1)}), and it concludes for s=4, not s>=5.  The s>=5 gap-closure claim exists ONLY in the non-arXiv OpenAI family-170 preprints (Sep 24 2026, sorry-stub Lean; see openai_evidence.json), not in the arXiv record.  => published frontier unchanged as of 2026-11-11.
